title: finish_process_message_3: missing poison on id_cred mismatch
description:
File: crates/oscore/src/edhoc/responder.rs
Line: 458
Function: finish_process_message_3
Category: missing-poison-on-error

## Description
Returns Err(EdhocError::SignatureVerification) without calling poison() when peer.id_cred does not match pending.id_cred. The pending.id_cred was extracted from peer message 3 in begin_process_message_3. This violates the invariant that all error paths after processing peer data must call poison(). State remains at lifecycle=PendingMessage3 with PRK values and transcript hashes intact in memory.

## Fix
Move the id_cred check inside the closure at line 461, or call self.poison() before returning at line 458. The closure pattern at lines 461-507 already handles poison() on error; extending it to include this check would be consistent.
